rv.q: In My Own Litle World succeeds both in presenting a captivating, tightly-paced 70 minutes of theatre, and in creating a space which truly feels safe and inclusive.
Simply put, IN MY OWN LITTLE WORLD is a triumph.

cn.t: Critics rave about Jaz Terry's solo show, awarding near-perfect scores. This semi-autobiographical trans coming-of-age piece earns praise for visceral storytelling and emotional resonance, marking it as essential theatre.
